blocked_when: editing/modification required but licence forbids derivatives
trademark/personality-rights review unresolved for intended use
accepted_examples: CC0 / Public Domain where no other restriction applies
CC BY-SA with attribution and ShareAlike compliance
Pexels licence subject to item-level third-party-rights check
Pixabay licence subject to prohibited uses and third-party-rights check
Coverr licence subject to brand/property checks
normally_blocked_examples: Creative Commons NonCommercial for monetized/commercial MDRN SportsQ
Creative Commons NoDerivatives when clipping/editing is required
Premier League/UEFA/FIFA/club highlight video without separate reuse permission
TikTok/Instagram reposts with no explicit reusable licence
